verdict.rationale: The only rule-style automation in the evidence is narrow and built-in. Auto-pay reloads the account balance when it drops below a user-set threshold, and Serverless flex workers scale to zero when idle. Nothing shows a general mechanism for users to define their own event-to-action rules. missing for 10: user-defined event rules/triggers, webhooks or event notifications, rules spanning Pods/Serverless/storage events, independent corroboration.
